# SOP-P2-L1-03 First-article inspection - Hot Forge line

Revision: Rev D  
Plant: P2, line P2-L1  
Equipment: EQ-P2-L1-RR01, EQ-P2-L1-IH02, EQ-P2-L1-SB03

1. Preconditions
   1.1. Ensure production authorization per SOP-P2-L1-01 and process setup complete per SOP-P2-L1-02.  
   1.2. Verify equipment ready: EQ-P2-L1-RR01 loaded, EQ-P2-L1-IH02 warmed and stable, EQ-P2-L1-SB03 cleaned and functional.  
   1.3. Confirm last maintenance records reviewed against SB-1001.

2. PPE
   2.1. Required PPE: hearing protection, face shield, heat-resistant gloves, flame-retardant apron, safety footwear.  
   2.2. Don PPE before entering the hot zone around EQ-P2-L1-IH02 and EQ-P2-L1-RR01.

3. First-article inspection procedure
   3.1. Start with visual inspection of incoming billet at EQ-P2-L1-RR01 for surface condition and correct orientation.  
   3.2. Feed a single billet through EQ-P2-L1-IH02. Stabilize and confirm the target billet temperature for Hot Forge induction billet heater #2 (EQ-P2-L1-IH02) is 1180 °C using calibrated thermocouple probe. Record reading on the FAI form.  
   3.3. Transfer heated billet to forging station and complete dimensional checks per SOP-P2-L1-01. Document deviations and stop if out-of-tolerance per SOP-P2-L1-02.

4. Shot blast and dust collector check
   4.1. After forging, process sample through EQ-P2-L1-SB03. Confirm shot blast finish meets surface specification.  
   4.2. Verify the dust collector pressure drop alarm for Hot Forge shot blast cabinet #3 (EQ-P2-L1-SB03) is 1240 Pa and record in inspection log. If alarm state differs, tag part and notify maintenance per SB-1001.

5. Acceptance criteria and disposition
   5.1. All measured values must match drawing and SOP acceptance criteria referenced in SOP-P2-L1-01.  
   5.2. Nonconforming parts require containment and disposition per SOP-P2-L1-02.

6. Sign-off
   6.1. Inspector name, signature, and date.  
   6.2. Supervisor review, signature, and date.  
   6.3. Enter FAI package into document control and reference SB-1001.
